> 第10章 初用古符文（第1页）
有了醒龙草，陆沉便配制了一份药材，回到房中炼制醒龙丹。
一枚醒龙丹入肚，化作一股精纯的药力，却不被身体吸收，而是围绕着炎龙脉转。
陆沉屏闭五观，魂力出识海，直下炎龙脉，渗入那股药力之中，并将之控制。
随后，古符文的记忆涌现，一个个古符文在识海流淌，无穷无尽，形成符文之海。
意念一动，一个古符文从符海冲出，通过魂力转入药力。
倾刻间，那股药力拥有那个古符文的奥义，化作一道符文药力。
符文药力随着意念引导，深深印入炎龙脉……
炎龙脉一动，九龙归一诀竟然自动运转。
房内那一点微弱的灵气，瞬间吸光。
一道道吸力被炎龙脉释放出来，门窗被吸得紧绷，摇摇欲爆。
炎龙脉已醒，需要汲取大量的天地灵气。
双木城的灵气非常稀薄，哪里够这条饿龙吸的？
很快，一道道吸力瞬间消失，房间恢复了平静。
取出灵气丹，陆沉脸上浮现一抹笑容。
三年前，陆沉觉醒玲珑武脉，受到家族重视，立为少主。
大长老更是将陆家的珍藏至宝千年龙元果，还有一枚下品灵气丹，全部送给陆沉。
千年龙元果，最终给陆沉带来沉重的代价。
但那枚下品灵气丹，陆沉倒是服用了。

当时，陆沉足足用了五天时间，才将丹药完全炼化，但仅吸收丹内蕴藏的五成灵气。
即使如此，陆沉也获益巨大，从炼体境三重突破到炼体境五重，足足提升了两个小境界。
如今，手中有五十枚下品灵气丹，是不是可以突破到真元境，恢复巅峰状态呢？
炎龙脉嗅到灵气，不断抖动，仿佛要破体而出。
陆沉连忙转运九龙归一诀，炎龙脉获得动力，疯狂般的汲取灵气。
灵气释放越来越快，丹药本体也越来越小。
一刻钟之后，灵气丹被炎龙脉炼化得一干二净，丹内蕴藏的所有灵气被吸收殆尽。
此时，炎龙脉红芒闪耀，将一道道精纯的灵气输入真元之种。
没想到一刻钟就完成了，太省时了。
如此推算，炼化五十枚灵气丹，都用不了一天。
他陆沉有炎龙武脉的加持，却有六千斤力。
而炼体境九重巅峰的陆荣，也仅是五千斤力而已。
理论上，陆沉可以碾压陆荣，甚至横扫同阶无敌手。
陆沉不相信理论，因为出现的意外太多了。
万一陆荣突破了真元境，那还怎么打？
大长老给的庇护只有七天，陆沉若不能在少主选拨赛上夺魁，就会失去所有支持。

> Chapter 10 Using Ancient Runes for the First Time (Page 1)
With the Awakening Dragon Grass, Lu Chen prepared a batch of medicinal ingredients and returned to his room to refine the Awakening Dragon Pill.
A Dragon Awakening Pill enters the belly and turns into a pure medicinal power. However, it is not absorbed by the body, but circulates around the Flame Dragon Veins.
Lu Chen closed his five senses, and his soul power came out of the sea of ​​consciousness, went straight down the Yanlong Vein, penetrated into the medicinal power, and controlled it.
Then, the memory of ancient runes emerged, and each ancient rune flowed endlessly in the sea of ​​consciousness, forming a sea of ​​runes.
With a thought, an ancient rune rushed out from the sea of ​​runes and was transferred into the medicine through soul power.
In an instant, the medicinal power possessed the secret meaning of that ancient rune and turned into a runic medicinal power.
The medicinal power of the runes is guided by thoughts and deeply imprinted into the Yanlong veins...
As soon as the Yanlong Vein moved, the Nine Dragons Returning to One Technique unexpectedly started to operate automatically.
The weak spiritual energy in the room was instantly absorbed.
A series of suction forces were released by the Flame Dragon Vein, and the doors and windows were sucked tight, shaking to the point of bursting.
The Flame Dragon Vein has awakened and needs to absorb a large amount of spiritual energy from heaven and earth.
The spiritual energy in Shuangmu City is very thin. Where can this hungry dragon absorb it?
Soon, the suction disappeared instantly and the room returned to calm.
Taking out the spiritual energy pill, a smile appeared on Lu Chen's face.
Three years ago, Lu Chen awakened the Linglong martial arts, gained the attention of his family, and was established as the young master.
The great elder even gave the Lu family's most precious treasure, the Millennium Dragon Yuan Fruit, and a low-grade spiritual energy pill to Lu Chen.
The Millennium Dragon Yuan Fruit ultimately brought a heavy price to Lu Chen.
But Lu Chen took the low-grade spiritual energy pill.
At that time, Lu Chen spent five days to completely refine the elixir, but only absorbed 50% of the spiritual energy contained in the elixir.
Even so, Lu Chen benefited greatly. He broke through from the third level of the Body Refining Realm to the fifth level of the Body Refining Realm, which was a full improvement of two small realms.
Now, with fifty low-grade spiritual energy pills in hand, can I break through to the True Yuan realm and return to peak condition?
The Yanlong Vein smelled the spiritual energy and kept shaking, as if it was about to burst out of the body.
Lu Chen quickly transferred the Nine Dragons Returning to One Technique, and the Flame Dragon Veins gained power, absorbing spiritual energy like crazy.
The spiritual energy is released faster and faster, and the elixir itself is getting smaller and smaller.
A quarter of an hour later, the spiritual energy pill was completely refined by the Yanlong Veins, and all the spiritual energy contained in the pill was absorbed.
At this time, the red light of the flame dragon veins shines, and pure spiritual energy is input into the true essence seed.
I didn't expect it to be completed in a quarter of an hour, it was such a time saver.
Based on this calculation, it would take less than a day to refine fifty spiritual energy pills.
He, Lu Chen, was blessed by the Yanlong martial arts, but he had six thousand kilograms of strength.
And Lu Rong, who was at the ninth level of the Body Refining Realm, only had a strength of five thousand kilograms.
Theoretically, Lu Chen could crush Lu Rong and even defeat invincible opponents at the same level.
Lu Chen didn't believe in the theory because there were too many surprises.
What if Lu Rong breaks through to the True Yuan Realm?
The protection given by the Great Elder is only seven days. If Lu Chen fails to win the Young Master Selection Competition, he will lose all support.
